The respondent No.2/complainant has fled the afdavit that she misunderstood the disclosure made by the victim to her about the alleged incident and lodged the report.
It is stated that she and victim do not have any objection if the applicant is released on bail.
Even otherwise from the medical evidence, it does not appear to be case of penetrative sexual assault.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and as the applicant is in jail for more than one year
, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
In the result, the following order is passed.
ORDER  A] Bail Application is allowed.

B] The applicant be released on bail in C.R. No. 379 of 2021 registered at Warje Malwadi Police Station, Pune for the ofences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3, 4, 5 (1) and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Ofences Act on furnishing P.R Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one or two sureties in the like amount.
